cv.name: Ciarán Egan
cv.headline: Post-Primary Teacher – Mathematics and Physics
cv.summary: Registered post-primary teacher of Mathematics and Physics with eight years in DEIS and Educate Together schools. I teach Junior and Senior Cycle to Higher Level, coordinate the school's STEM week and enjoy getting reluctant students to like maths.

experience.title: Teacher of Mathematics and Physics
bullets: Teach Junior Cycle Maths and Leaving Certificate Higher Level Physics and Applied Maths
Higher Level Maths uptake in my Leaving Cert classes rose from 31% to 48% over three years
Coordinate Classroom-Based Assessments for the Maths department and moderate SLAR meetings
Run the school's Young Scientist entries and the Transition Year STEM module

experience.title: Teacher of Mathematics
bullets: Taught Junior and Senior Cycle Maths, including remote teaching on Google Classroom during school closures
Year head assistant for second year

experience.title: Substitute Teacher
bullets: Covered Maths and Science classes across first to fifth year

skills: Junior Cycle and Leaving Certificate curricula
certifications: Registered with the Teaching Council (Post-Primary, Mathematics and Physics)
